description: I defined this policy set to govern AI-assisted investment intelligence, establishing that the system produces analysis while investment professionals retain judgment, capital allocation, and decision authority.
appliesTo: Deal Intelligence Pipeline — private real estate acquisition screening, underwriting support, and investment committee preparation

policies.name: Human Decision Authority
policies.summary: I established that no AI output constitutes an investment decision and that decision authority remains with named individuals.
controls: Prohibit autonomous rejection of any opportunity from the pipeline
Require a named human reviewer for every decline at screening
Reserve capital allocation authority to the investment committee
Present all scores as decision support rather than recommendation

policies.name: Score Traceability
policies.summary: I required that any score presented to a human resolve to the inputs, sources, and weights that produced it.
controls: Record data source and vintage for every scoring input
Display the dimension profile alongside any composite score
Attach a confidence indicator derived from input completeness and provenance
Record defaults and proxies used to fill data gaps

policies.name: Model Change Control
policies.summary: I classified scoring model changes as governance changes requiring approval before deployment.
controls: Version every model with weights, inputs, and effective date
Require documented rationale and human approval for weight or logic changes
Require independent review of model logic before deployment
Retain prior versions so historical scores remain reproducible

policies.name: Extraction Verification
policies.summary: I defined extracted document values as unverified until confirmed by a reviewer.
controls: Link every extracted field to its source document and page
Flag low-confidence extractions for human verification before scoring
Carry verification status on any figure reaching an investment committee package
Prohibit silent use of unverified values in committee materials

policies.name: Committee Material Approval
policies.summary: I required human review and approval before any AI-assisted briefing reaches the investment committee.
controls: Require a named analyst to review and approve each briefing before distribution
Label all AI-assisted material as AI-assisted
Retain inputs, model versions, and scenario definitions with each briefing
Ensure any briefing can be regenerated exactly as the committee received it

policies.name: Override Capture
policies.summary: I required that human decisions diverging from model output be recorded, treating divergence as a governance signal rather than an exception to suppress.
controls: Record rationale for every decision that diverges from model output
Review overrides quarterly for systematic divergence
Treat consistent one-directional divergence as a model calibration finding
Escalate unstated criteria surfaced by overrides to the calibration review

policies.name: Decline Record Retention
policies.summary: I required declined opportunities to be retained with rationale so that screening consistency and false negative exposure remain observable.
controls: Record rationale, dimension scores, and reviewer for every decline
Review declines periodically for systematic bias by market, asset type, or partner
Sample low-ranked opportunities to test whether ranking suppresses viable deals
Retain decline records as part of the institutional knowledge base

policies.name: Model Scope Limitation
policies.summary: I limited each model to the opportunity types it was calibrated for and defined out-of-scope application as a governance exception.
controls: Document the asset types and business plans each model covers
Document known limitations and inapplicable conditions with the model
Require approval before applying a model outside its documented scope
Review scope and limitations on an annual cycle

policies.name: Data Sensitivity and Access
policies.summary: I applied elevated sensitivity classification to internal performance data, partner performance detail, and investor information.
controls: Enforce existing entitlement boundaries on internal investment records
Restrict partner-level performance detail to authorized reviewers
Classify opportunity data received under confidentiality accordingly
Log access to sensitive investment data for audit

policies.name: Model Monitoring and Calibration
policies.summary: I defined a monitoring and calibration cycle bounded by the limited outcome data a low-acquisition-rate strategy produces.
controls: Monitor input and score distribution drift on a quarterly cycle
Backtest model behavior against realized outcomes annually
Prohibit weight changes justified by statistically insufficient outcome data
Require documented rationale rather than fit improvement alone for calibration changes

policies.name: Claim Boundaries
policies.summary: I defined the claims this system may make about its own capability, to prevent representations the evidence cannot support.
controls: Prohibit representation of model output as return prediction
Prohibit representation of the system as a substitute for underwriting judgment
Limit stated capability to consistency, capacity, pattern detection, and preparation efficiency
Exclude investment performance from system evaluation metrics

policies.name: No Autonomous Action
policies.summary: I prohibited the system from taking any action beyond producing analysis.
controls: Prohibit transaction execution and capital commitment
Prohibit external communication to sellers, brokers, or partners without human approval
Prohibit modification of underwriting models or portfolio records without approval
Restrict system output to analysis delivered to human reviewers
